title: 第21章 怪力乱神突破炼体一境第22章 师姐出手血凰神女诛邪箭
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
这形意六合拳，太过熟练了！
像是一位练拳多年的老师傅！
若非李浪跟她是同时拿到武学，倪嫣都以为李浪以前可能就修炼过这门武学。
所以，唯一的解释，李浪这厮不会昨夜回去，一夜未睡，都在加练吧？
哇，不得好死的卷狗！
倪嫣抿了下面纱下的红唇，直面卷狗，内心深处不由产生一种紧迫感，也顾不得和清清玩耍，开始修炼起来。
然而，跟着李浪的节奏，修炼了半天，倪嫣就气喘吁吁，摆手停下。
“不练了，不练了！”
听着倪嫣释放娇声的喘息。
李浪也从修炼状态中停下，浑身躁动气血慢慢归于沉寂。
继而，肌肉中堆积的乳酸，便轰然爆发，发麻酸痛感席卷遍布。
“浪师弟，你就是牲畜！”
倪嫣白了李浪一眼，继续娇声喘息，初具规模的山峰上下起伏，面纱被吹的微微扬起，露出若隐若现的光洁下巴。
李浪自顾自倒了杯茶水猛灌，“技艺锁”
中，收录形意六合拳的白色清气，开始于筋骨之间游走，化开堆积的乳酸，熬炼皮膜。
皮膜微微发热，李浪觉得，再按照这节奏修炼个两三天，便能打熬完浑身皮膜，完成炼体第一境，进而开始熬炼肌肉。
炼体生气，乃是武道之中一个重要的打基础过程。
哪怕武道天赋绝佳，也需要按部就班，一步一个脚印的打熬磨炼！
至于五行拳，因为有神工之心收录清气，提升感悟的缘故，李浪再演练几遍，应该就能登临“初窥门径”
的第一层境界。

如此进度，李浪很是满意。
在休息的间隙，李浪不由想到昨夜神工之心汲取的鬼神纹，便看向了身边的倪嫣，询问她关于鬼神之道的事情。
“鬼神之道的境界？”
倪嫣一愣。
似乎疑惑于李浪无法修鬼神纹，问这个做什么。
不过，她还是回答了。
“鬼神第一境为凝纹境，凝纹九道便可尝试开精神紫府，于紫府之内，纹鬼神台，是为第二境。”
“至于再往后的鬼神第三境，是为丹纹境……那等存在，或许唯有云梦郡城那边才会存在，与武道宗师一般十分罕见。”
倪嫣长长的睫毛轻颤，乌黑眸子闪烁，好似有几分向往。
凝纹、纹台、丹纹……
这便是鬼神道的境界么？！
后面肯定还有更高的境界，不过，倪嫣不说……李澈也不好继续询问这个方面了。
随后，转移话题，李浪又好奇询问了一些鬼神道的细节，借口说为清清以后的鬼神修炼，提前了解，好为她铺路。
“鬼神纹……其实有分类的。”
倪嫣听到李浪是为了清清考虑，倒是认真起来，介绍的更加详细了些。
“你且看我！”
她站起身，身上的红色劲装顿时飞扬，捆束马尾的绒绳顿时绷断，满头青丝狂舞飞扬。
她双掌合十，下一刻，乌黑如枣的眼珠，迸发赤色光芒！
她的背后，有一尊模糊的“火焰神女”
虚影浮现而出，神女好似在赤色火焰中滚滚燃烧，满头发丝如焰火飞扬，双手掌心相对，徐徐闭合。

三道赤色纹路，宛如灵动的游蛇蜿蜒交织。
一股无形且压抑的鬼神威压，像是黑云压城般，瞬息扩张开来。
content_en:
This Xingyi Liuhe Fist is so proficient!
Like a master who has been practicing boxing for many years!
If Li Lang and she hadn't obtained martial arts at the same time, Ni Yan would have thought that Li Lang might have practiced this martial arts before.
Therefore, the only explanation is that Li Lang didn't go back last night and stayed up all night to practice extra, right?
Wow, what a miserable curly dog!
Ni Yan pursed her red lips under the veil and faced the curly dog. She couldn't help but feel a sense of urgency deep in her heart. She didn't care about playing with Qingqing and started to practice.
However, after practicing for a long time following Li Lang's rhythm, Ni Yan was out of breath and waved her hands to stop.
"No more practice, no more practice!"
Listen to Ni Yan's breath of release.
Li Lang also stopped from his cultivation state, and the restless energy and blood in his body slowly returned to silence.
Then, the lactic acid accumulated in the muscles exploded, causing numbness and soreness to spread all over.
"Junior Brother Lang, you are just an animal!"
Ni Yan rolled her eyes at Li Lang and continued to breathe softly. The mountain peaks that were beginning to take shape rose and fell, and the veil was blown up slightly, revealing a looming smooth chin.
Li Lang poured a cup of tea and drank it, "Skills Lock"
In it, the white Qi from Xingyi Liuhe Quan begins to travel between the muscles and bones, dissolving the accumulated lactic acid and tempering the skin membrane.
The skin membrane was slightly hot, and Li Lang felt that if he practiced at this pace for two or three more days, he would be able to finish the skin membrane all over his body, complete the first stage of body training, and then start to exercise his muscles.
Refining the body to create vitality is an important foundational process in martial arts.
Even if you have excellent martial arts talent, you still need to practice step by step and practice step by step!
As for the Five Elements Boxing, because he has a magical heart to collect the pure energy and improve his perception, Li Lang should be able to reach the "first glimpse of the door" by practicing it a few more times.
The first level of realm.
Li Lang was very satisfied with this progress.
During the break, Li Lang couldn't help but think of the ghost and god patterns that he had absorbed last night with his divine craftsmanship. He looked at Ni Yan beside him and asked her about the way of ghosts and gods.
"The realm of ghosts and gods?"
Ni Yan was stunned.
He seemed to be confused about Li Lang's inability to cultivate ghost and god patterns, and asked what he was doing.
Still, she answered.
"The first realm of ghosts and gods is the realm of condensing patterns. The nine realms of condensing patterns can try to open the spiritual purple mansion. Within the purple mansion, the stage of ghosts and gods is the second realm."
"As for the third realm of ghosts and gods that follows, it is the Alchemy Realm... Such existences may only exist in Yunmeng County, and they are as rare as martial arts masters."
Ni Yan's long eyelashes trembled slightly, and her black eyes flickered, as if she was yearning for him.
Condensation pattern, pattern pattern, red pattern...
Is this the realm of ghosts and gods? !
There must be a higher level in the future, but if Ni Yan doesn't say it... Li Che can't continue to ask about this aspect.
Then, changing the topic, Li Lang curiously asked about some details of the ghost and god way, on the pretext that he wanted to know in advance about the ghost and god cultivation after Qingqing, so as to pave the way for her.
"Ghost and God Patterns...actually have categories."
When Ni Yan heard that Li Lang was considering Qingqing, she became serious and introduced it in more detail.
"Look at me!"
She stood up, the red outfit on her body suddenly flew up, the velvet rope binding her ponytail suddenly broke, and her black hair flew wildly.
She clasped her palms together, and the next moment, her eyes as black as jujubes burst out with red light!
Behind her, there is a vague "Flame Goddess"
A phantom emerged, the goddess seemed to be burning in red flames, her hair was flying like fireworks, her palms faced each other, and they slowly closed.
Three red lines intertwined like agile snakes.
An invisible and oppressive pressure from ghosts and gods spread out instantly, like a black cloud pressing over a city.
